registration: local analysis plan; not external preregistration
scope: exploratory observational cross-species association; no causal or functional claims

sampling.sample_species_aggregation: mean within recorded colony, then equal-weight mean across recorded colonies within species
sampling.species_with_one_colony: retain with explicit uncertainty flag; no within-species biological CI
sampling.minimum_species_note: operational reporting safeguard, not a power guarantee

alpha.rng_policy: numpy Generator PCG64; sorted sample IDs; SeedSequence spawn; pin NumPy version
alpha.rarefaction_diagnostics: descriptive depth/coverage curves; not used to optimize association p-values

beta.normalization: sample relative abundance from unrarefied counts
beta.species_profile: mean sample composition within colony, then equal-weight mean across colonies
beta.ordination: PCoA; report negative eigenvalues; do not silently alter distances

nlr.exposure: unique gene loci with canonical NACHT plus downstream LRR evidence in the representative protein
nlr.label: canonical-architecture NLR candidates; not the complete functional NLR repertoire
nlr.target_scope: nine matched species; primary analyses use eight eligible species
nlr.gene_mapping: GTF transcript/protein to gene mapping; verify IDs against FASTA
nlr.representative_isoform: longest amino-acid sequence excluding terminal stop; ties resolved lexicographically by protein ID
nlr.sequence_qc: exclude internal-stop proteins from primary representative selection; retain flags and rejected IDs; if all isoforms fail, count locus as unresolved, not absent
nlr.hmm_threshold: model-specific sequence and domain GA cutoffs (--cut_ga); no universal E-value threshold substituted
nlr.architecture_rule: at least one accepted NACHT domain and one accepted LRR model match whose alignment start is after NACHT alignment end in the same representative protein
nlr.domain_overlap: for competing repeat-model hits with overlap greater than 50% of shorter aligned region, retain highest domain bit-score; ties by accession
nlr.locus_count: count each gene once regardless of domains, hits or isoforms
alternate_exposures: any-isoform canonical architecture, one count per locus
NB-ARC-containing loci separately; do not pool automatically
canonical candidate loci per 10000 annotated genes
nlr.blast_role: supporting homology evidence and specificity review; neither a mandatory human-match filter nor functional proof

blast_reporting.database: small versioned reference panel, not nr

nlr.qc_exclusions: exclude unresolved protein-to-gene mapping or unreadable/missing annotation; BUSCO below 90% is a sensitivity exclusion, not automatic primary exclusion
nlr.missing_values: missing/unusable genomes are NA; verified successful zero detections are 0
nlr.pilot_gate: verify model/ID/coordinate behavior and controls before full run; sequence classification is blind to microbiome outcomes; amendments must precede association tests

A.question: Higher canonical candidate counts are associated with higher species-mean Shannon diversity
A.statistic: Spearman rho of gene count and species-mean standardized Shannon

B.question: Species with more similar canonical candidate counts have more similar microbiome compositions
B.statistic: Spearman Mantel statistic on upper triangles
B.test: two-sided permutation of species labels, moving matrix rows and columns together
B.limitations: not a causal test or phylogeny correction; pairwise entries are not independent replicates

statistics.exact_p: number with abs(stat)>=abs(observed), including identity, divided by all label permutations
statistics.ties: average ranks; retain tied outcomes in null distribution
statistics.constant_or_too_few_species: report undefined/descriptive only; never replace with zero association
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment across A and B on the primary cohort; reserve two-test family even if one endpoint undefined
statistics.interpretation: nominal exploratory p-values assume exchangeability; shared ancestry/site effects can violate it
statistics.covariates: no multivariable primary model at current species count
uncertainty: subsampling variability labelled Monte Carlo, not biological confidence
statistics.PERMANOVA: not in v1 primary analysis; any later addition requires a versioned plan and species-level/appropriate cluster permutation design

phylogeny.current_tree: not accepted as species-level PGLS input
tree_acceptance: one documented tip per eligible species
no genus-only substitution or shared mitochondrial tip relabeling
finite nonnegative branches and nonsingular covariance on retained tips
phylogeny.conditional_model: species-mean Shannon ~ log1p(canonical count), Brownian covariance with lambda fixed at 1
phylogeny.conditional_contrast: lambda fixed at 0 as model sensitivity; no lambda optimization with eight species
phylogeny.status: secondary conditional analysis only; if no adequate tree, omit PGLS and state ancestry unadjusted
phylogeny.geography: report species-by-site and expedition coverage; do not claim adjusted geography when confounded

sensitivities.depth_policy: repeat alpha subsampling at that depth, recompute eligibility and profiles; report lost species
sensitivities.quality: exclude BUSCO C below 90%; flag source OCR uncertainty
sensitivities.site_analysis: largest sampling expedition represented by at least 5 eligible species; ties lexicographic; otherwise report unavailable
sensitivities.reporting: report all scheduled results and eligibility changes; no best-p-value selection or exhaustive factorial fishing

change_control.new_data_versions: amendment required; no silent replacement of v1 annotation
change_control.technical_amendment: document rationale, files, old/new values, timing and whether any outcome association was viewed; never overwrite v1
change_control.post_association_change: explicitly exploratory deviation; preserve original result
change_control.stop_if_no_informative_exposure: report inability to assess A/B; do not loosen thresholds after inspecting outcomes

deliverables: species-level canonical and alternate count table
primary A/B results with Holm adjustment
